verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is an API-driven sales-tax SaaS, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents a REST API, five official SDKs and a docs-only MCP server, but none of them is a command-line tool. These are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
